blind_review.old_human_answers: development only, no new independent labels
blind_review.qualification: limited audit; assistant blind reading is not independent human qualification
blind_review.reviewer_identity: unassigned; actual provenance recorded before review
blind_review.selected_task_rule: first fact and first natural_support in frozen task order

direct_failure_review: additional development explanation only; not substituted into fixed blind eight
interpretation: program checks identities and entered observations, not their semantic truth

nli.role: optional existing auxiliary source/claim diagnostic only

structured_branch.scope: only original finite JSON fields, explicit source reference, exact original contract

substantive_answer_rule: A cited or supplied passage is not an answer by itself: review the proposition answering the actual question, actor, report/event time, stage, polarity, uncertainty and relevant alternatives.
